verdict.rationale: Deepgram's Twilio integration guide says the Voice Agent supports barge-in: the caller can talk over the agent and it stops instantly, and the conversation can be interrupted mid-sentence. That covers the stop-speech part of the story, but the evidence never describes how the interrupted turn updates the conversation context or how the agent recovers the turn. Missing for 10: documentation of context updates after interruption (e.g., truncating unspoken agent text), turn-recovery behavior and related events/settings, and independent or hands-on corroboration of barge-in quality.
